title: [Decision] The copilot's drafts: who sees a copilot change before publish, and where — preview-first (A), auto-publish additive edits (B), sticky author preview (C) or a dev environment (D); the frame #24298 waits on
body:
Ruled: 6250704607 · letter A · 2026-10-18T13:51Z

Filed by the director seat (summon #43 continuation 5, `session_01QJC7i981TSs9L1CGJK59Ax`) on the maintainer's words in this session's chat, verbatim: 「决裁 24298 AI 副驾 如果保存的是草稿的话，实际上不只是设计器，界面上也显示不出来。所以这个问题要综合评估。」 — the frame objectstack-ai/objectstack#24298 (per-key draft provenance for Studio's 草稿 chip; `pm:dispatched`, held on the maintainer's word) waits on. ⛔ Not a claim. Platform first (the maintainer's 口径 「平台相关的功能，应该尽量先改平台。」): the governing ADRs are this repository's.

## 维护者速读

**今天的事实(源码读数,未实机走查):** AI 副驾改一个已发布应用里的东西(字段、视图、页面)时,存的是草稿。草稿只有「搭建者」看得见:持有 `studio.access` / `setup.access` / `manage_metadata` 的人,在三个地方 —— 带 `?preview=draft` 的预览模式(Live Canvas 和应用内的「草稿预览」水印条)、Studio 的「变更」抽屉、聊天里的「已存为草稿」卡片(带发布和查看变更按钮)。普通成员在应用里看到的永远是已发布的版本,一个字节都不差;这是 ADR-0033「AI 只写草稿,发布是人的闸门」定的,有测试钉住。整个应用的首次生成是例外:lint 干净就当场发布,只对非搭建者隐藏(ADR-0045)。增量修改不走这条路,所以一直是草稿。

**您说的「界面上也显示不出来」成立,而且有两层。** 一层是入口:聊天里的「预览」按钮只在草稿里含应用时才出现,改一个字段就没有预览入口,只能去 Studio 或者盲发布。另一层是本质:草稿字段没有存储(建表只在发布时做),`/data` 永远不读草稿,所以预览能看到新字段,却填不进数据。要「带数据看到」,只有发布。

**要您定的:** 副驾的改动在发布之前,应该让谁、在哪里看到。四个方向见下表。席位推荐 A:补齐预览入口与 Studio 标记,发布仍是人的闸门;B 是把「新增类」改动也当场发布。

## What exists today (read at objectstack `3fed1eb00af6`, objectui `a8560b228527`, cloud `837e24a4b8b4`)

| Who | Where | Sees a copilot draft? | Anchor |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| Plain member | the running app, `/meta`, `/data` | No — published only, byte-identical | `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts:23530–23547`; `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts:1837`; `rest/src/meta-published-overlay.test.ts:261` |
| Builder | `?preview=draft` (Live Canvas; the in-app DraftPreviewBar) | Yes — a metadata overlay; a draft-only field or object has no storage, so no data | `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta.ts:1631`; objectui `app-shell/src/preview/PreviewModeContext.tsx:12–33`, `preview/DraftPreviewBar.tsx` |
| Builder | Studio | the 变更 badge counts drafts, the diff drawer shows them; properties cannot mark them per key (#24298) | objectui `StudioDesignSurface.tsx:1288`; `preview/DraftChangesPanel.tsx` |
| Builder | the chat | an amber 「drafted」 badge, Publish, Review N changes; Preview only when the draft set includes an app | objectui `plugin-chatbot` `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx:3068–3076`, `:2518–2566` |
| Anyone | a whole-app build | published in-turn when lint is clean, hidden from non-builders by `_unpublished` (ADR-0045) | cloud `service-ai-studio/tools/blueprint-tools.ts:4912–4917`; objectstack `rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts:922` |

- Saving defaults to publish; the copilot's write tools choose `mode: 'draft'` (cloud `service-ai-studio/tools/metadata-tools.ts:1523–1581`); `applyDraft` returns `changedKeys` and the note 「NOT LIVE … ask them to publish」 (`:1589–1636`).
- `autoPublishAiBuilds` (cloud ADR-0012; default on unless `OS_AI_AUTOPUBLISH_DISABLED`) auto-publishes package-bound, lint-clean drafts only; incremental edits are not marked `autoPublishable` (`:5157–5170`).
- Drafts are environment-global with no actor or conversation tag (cloud ADR-0070); `publishPackageDrafts` is one atomic, revertible commit (ADR-0067).
- Governing: ADR-0033 (AI drafts, the human publishes), ADR-0037 (draft-overlay preview, accepted and implemented), ADR-0045 (additive builds publish behind `_unpublished`), cloud ADR-0084 (Proposed: publish only when everything passes).

## Options

| Option | What changes | Who sees what | Workload |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| **A · Preview-first: every draft is one click from being seen; publish stays the gate (seat's recommendation)** | chat: the Preview button appears for any draft and deep-links to the affected page or object in `?preview=draft`; the in-app DraftPreviewBar names what is pending; Studio marks copilot drafts per key (#24298 as filed: the spec key, the engine writer, cloud's stamp, Studio's chip and 来源 line); the home banner stays | builders see the draft wherever they look; members see nothing until publish | objectui S (chat Preview + deep link) · the #24298 chain as graded (spec S, engine S, cloud S, objectui S) |
| **B · Auto-publish additive incremental edits** | ADR-0045's rule extends from whole-app builds to additive edits on an existing app (a new field, view, page): lint-clean → published in-turn, revertible (ADR-0067); modifying or destructive edits stay drafts | the author and every member see a new field at once, with storage; drafts remain only for changes to existing things | cloud S–M (`autoPublishable` for additive edits plus the posture rule) · ADR-0045 amendment (Tier H) · A's Studio marking still wanted for the remaining drafts |
| **C · Sticky author preview** | a builder with pending drafts opens the app in draft mode by default (DraftPreviewBar on), without the URL flag | builders always see the overlay; members unchanged; a draft field still has no data | objectui S · A's data limit unchanged |
| **D · Edit in a development environment, promote by package** | copilot edits land live in a development environment; production changes only by publishing the package there | the author sees everything live, with data; production untouched until promotion | cloud M–L; the Free plan has no development environment |

## Recommendation: A, with B as the one widening worth its own letter

- **Long-term fit.** ADR-0033, 0037 and 0045 are one coherent model: new things go live hidden, changes to live things are drafts that builders preview and a human publishes. What the maintainer hit are entrances (no Preview for a field draft; no per-key mark in Studio), not the model. A completes the ruled design; objectui#12725 item 3 and #24298 are A's Studio half.
- **Business pull.** The maintainer's own walk; the AI building loop needs 「say it, see it」 (ADR-0037's design centre). The inherent limit stays under A and C: a draft field holds no data, so seeing it with data means publishing — which is B's pull.
- **AI-error surface.** A keeps the human gate for every change to a live app. B publishes additive edits in-turn: safe for data (nothing existing is touched) but visible to members at once, so it needs the 「live app with data」 posture rule (objectui#12725 change card v2) to stay honest. C and D add no AI risk.
- **Startup, no spread.** A: one objectui card plus the #24298 chain already graded; B: a cloud change plus a Tier H ADR amendment; D is a capability build.
- **If the maintainer wants 见即所得 without a preview step,** B is the letter; #24298 still applies to the drafts that remain.

## Execution

- **A:** #24298 resumes as filed (its seat lifts the hold); the director files objectui p2 `pm:queue` — the chat's Preview button for any draft, deep-linked to the affected page in `?preview=draft`; this card closes `completed`.
- **B:** #24298 resumes; the director files cloud p1 `pm:queue` (additive incremental edits `autoPublishable` behind lint, with the posture rule) and an objectstack Tier H card (the ADR-0045 amendment; the maintainer merges); A's objectui card too.
- **C:** #24298 resumes; one objectui card (sticky preview). **D:** a cloud capability card; #24298 resumes.

os-decision-facets
① 项目长远合理性:A —— ADR-0033/0037/0045 是一套自洽模型(新建即发布但隐藏;改动成草稿、搭建者预览、人来发布);您撞到的是入口缺口,不是模型错;#24298 是 A 在 Studio 的那一半。
② 实际业务拉动:您的走查;AI 搭建要「说了就看见」;「草稿字段没有数据」这层限制 A、C 都解不了,只有发布能解,这是 B 的拉动。
③ 防 AI 犯错:A 保留每个改动的人工闸门;B 把新增类改动当场发布,数据安全但成员立刻可见,需要「有数据的活应用」姿态规则;C、D 不新增风险。
④ 创业阶段不扩散:A 一张 objectui 卡加已评级的 #24298 链;B 多一处 cloud 改动和一次 Tier H ADR 修订;D 是能力建设。
